rules.when: The project is a phone or tablet app installed on a device.
rules.why: Set the mobile stack here to make the preference explicit; empty falls back to the default below.

rules.when: The project is a browser-facing site or web app.
rules.why: Name the web stack you want maintained instead of letting each task pick one.

rules.when: The project installs as a desktop application.
rules.why: A desktop stack is a long-lived commitment, so record it once here.

rules.when: The project is a command-line tool.
rules.why: CLI tools get rewritten most often; a written preference stops the churn.

rules.when: The project is a server, service, or API.
rules.why: A backend runtime is the costliest to change later, so record the intent up front.

default.why: No stack is preferred. Pick the stack that fits the project, then write it into the rule above when it should hold for the next one.
